framework: OpenAI Whisper v20250625; PyTorch 2.10.0 official ROCm 7.1 wheel; Python 3.12
cuda_or_triton_requirements: Whisper uses PyTorch CUDA device APIs, which ROCm intentionally reuses. Linux x86_64 declares Triton >=2.0; PyTorch's ROCm wheel supplies triton-rocm, but pip does not treat that distribution as satisfying Whisper's generic Triton dependency. Basic transcription passed without an HSA architecture override; the Fedora system HSA runtime had to be preloaded because PyTorch's bundled HSA library crashed on the first GPU tensor operation.
maintenance_status: Latest upstream release v20250625, published 26 June 2025; pinned release includes current-Triton compatibility fixes.
